notes: Index intentionally excludes itself; every listed saved artifact has actual byte size and SHA-256.

Source paths are historical original locations, not a promise that an output path still has the same content after later reruns; stored relative path and SHA-256 identify the authoritative preserved file.
Final unprofiled mini-ui is mini-ui/; old pre-font mini-ui is mini-ui-before-font-init/. The old comparison is explicitly comparison-before-font-init.json.
Actual native BMP images are converted losslessly to RGB PNG without resizing; original source-image hashes are retained where available. Chrome PNG captures are original outputs.
Profiler/forced-GC/debugger diagnostic samples and failed attempts are never pooled into final unprofiled timings.
